summary.text: Penny Brown Reynolds is the Democratic nominee for Secretary of State. She is an attorney and former judge of the State Court of Fulton County who also worked in the U.S. Department of Agriculture during the Biden administration.

paragraphs.text: Earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice (1991) and a law degree (1994) from Georgia State University, a master's degree from the Interdenominational Theological Center (2008), and a Ph.D. in criminal justice from Nova Southeastern University (2021).
Served as a judge of the State Court of Fulton County.
